aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Class 3-E students balance their high school lives with the ultimate mission to assassinate their powerful, alien teacher, Koro-sensei, before he destroys the Earth.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time brings back the outcast students of Class 3-E as they embark on fresh, high-stakes adventures while training under their unusual teacher, Koro-sensei. Despite being a tentacles-laden creature capable of moving at Mach 20, Koro-sensei turns out to be the best educator these academic underachievers have ever had. As Nagisa and his classmates hone their assassination skills, they must reconcile their affection for their mentor with the duty of saving the planet. Through shared struggles and laughter, the students discover their true potential both on and off the battlefield.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The movie delves deeper into the unique dynamic of Kunugigaoka Junior High School's infamous Class 3-E, a group of academic misfits assigned to a remote mountain campus. Their target is Koro-sensei, an enigmatic, tentacled creature responsible for destroying a large portion of the moon, who now threatens to blow up Earth in one year unless his students can eliminate him. However, Koro-sensei genuinely cares for his students' personal growth, providing tailored education and life guidance that boosts their self-esteem. Throughout their new adventures, main protagonist Nagisa Shiota and his classmate Karma Akabane reflect on how much Koro-sensei's bizarre teaching methods have transformed their lives. As dangerous external assassins and military forces attempt to claim the bounty on Koro-sensei's head, Class 3-E must defend their classroom and their right to carry out the mission themselves. The film highlights key moments of bond-building, tactical growth, and emotional maturity as the deadline for Earth's destruction draws closer. Ultimately, the students are forced to grapple with the bitter sweet realization that their beloved teacher is prepping them not just to kill him, but to thrive long after he is gone. The journey culminates in a poignant celebration of youth, resilience, and the unforgettable mark left by an extraordinary educator.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time follows Nagisa Shiota, Karma Akabane, and the rest of Class 3-E—a group of struggling middle schoolers tasked with assassinating their smile-faced, super-powered alien teacher, Koro-sensei. Set in a world where a Mach-20 monster double-agents as a dedicated educator, the story balances sci-fi action, comedic school-life antics, and heartfelt drama as the students learn essential life lessons while attempting to save the world.

story_structure.climax: With only days remaining before the ultimate deadline, the students confront their final assignment, coming face-to-face with the emotional reality of their mission and the true extent of Koro-sensei's impact on their lives.
story_structure.conflict: The central struggle emerges as the outcast students must balance their academic growth and personal development with their government-assigned mission to eliminate Koro-sensei, all while forming a deep bond with him as a mentor.
story_structure.resolution: The students accept the lessons Koro-sensei bestowed upon them, preparing to step into their respective futures while honoring the unbreakable bond and guidance left behind by their teacher.
story_structure.introduction: Class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School is introduced alongside their homeroom teacher, Koro-sensei—a tentacled, superpowered creature who destroyed part of the moon and threatens to destroy Earth unless his students can assassinate him before graduation.
story_structure.risingAction: As the deadline approaches, the students reflect on their shared memories, hone their assassination techniques during unconventional lessons, face external threats from rival hitmen, and contend with increasing government surveillance.

faq.answer: Yes, the film includes additional scenes following the main story that offer extra closure and sentimental moments reflecting on Class 3-E's journey with Koro-sensei.
